Original Japanese (Vita):
黒装束の女がフードをはずすと、
長い黒髪がきらめいた。
それを見て金髪の少女もいそいそとフードを脱いだ。
Official English (Switch):
The woman lowers her hood, her black hair
shimmering as it cascades the length of her
back, and the little girl does the same.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The woman lowers her hood, her black
hair shimmering down the length of her
back. The little girl does the same.

Original Japanese (Vita):
沢蟹の意匠の封蝋がされた手紙に、
ドロニアは目を落とす。
Official English (Switch):
Dronya takes out a letter and begins to read
it. The broken sealing wax on the letter bears
the impression of a crab.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Dronya takes out a letter and
reads it. Its broken wax seal
bears the impression of a crab.

Original Japanese (Vita):
酒酔いの記憶ほどあてにならない物は
ございませんし、それに……その下品な物言い。
案内頂けるほど賢そうにも思えませんが。
Official English (Switch):
I know better than to trust a drunk's
memory. Besides, you don't seem quite
intelligent enough to be our guide.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I know better than to trust a
drunk's memory. You hardly seem
smart enough to be our guide.

Original Japanese (Vita):
そして、ここに停めたこの“馬車小屋”こそが、
我々の拠点であり、退屈極まりない日常をおくる
鉄の監獄……と、いったところだ。
Official English (Switch):
The caravan shall serve as our base of
operations, and the prison from which we
must send those...tedious daily reports.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The caravan is our base,
and our prison, sending
those tedious daily reports.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ドロニアはメーメの一瞬の隙を突き、
井戸の中に蹴落とした！
これは酷い行いだ！
Official English (Switch):
The moment Bah-Bah looked away, Dronya gave
the lamb a firm kick and sent the poor thing
tumbling down the well! How horrible!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Bah-Bah looks away. Dronya kicks the
poor lamb down the well! How horrible!

Original Japanese (Vita):
この本は“妖路歴程”――
忌み嫌われる呪われた本の名前であり……
そして、今この瞬間からキミ自身の名さ！
Official English (Switch):
Why, this feared, cursed book is known
as the Tractatus de Monstrum...
And from now on, that's what you are!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
This feared, cursed book is
Tractatus de Monstrum...
And that's who you are now!

Original Japanese (Vita):
何せ、男はすでに正気を失ってて、書き上げたら
そのままぽっくり逝っちゃったってんだから。
……まあ、誰も信じないよね。
Official English (Switch):
Cuz the guy who wrote this book up and died
after he finished it. That sorta detail tends
to make people skeptical.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Cuz the guy who wrote it died
after finishing it. That detail
tends to make folks skeptical.

Original Japanese (Vita):
まあ、キミは“妖路歴程”、運命を記憶する書物だ。
他の人がその名を口にすることは
ないだろうけど名前は大事だよ……うん！
Official English (Switch):
You may be the Tractatus de Monstrum, the
book that records fate, but your name is still
important even if no one calls you by it.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You're Tractatus de Monstrum,
the book of fate. Your name
matters even if no one uses it.

Original Japanese (Vita):
う・る・さ・い！
それに街にいるあいだは、魔女様とは絶対に呼ぶな。
辺境では魔女を忌み嫌う連中も多い。
Official English (Switch):
Shut up! And NEVER call me a witch while
we're in the town. The peasants in this
backwater do not take kindly to witches.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Shut up! NEVER call me a
witch in town. These backwater
peasants hate witches.

Original Japanese (Vita):
それとも、魔女の秘薬で
お前の“真名”をしゃべらせてやろうか？
そうすれば、お前は完全なる下僕だぞ……？
Official English (Switch):
Or shall I prepare a special potion?
One that will force you to say your true
name, so I can make you more...obedient.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Shall I brew a potion to force
you to say your true name and
make you more...obedient?

Original Japanese (Vita):
こいつ……出発した時には感じなかった
マナの流れ――いや……アニマの気配を感じるぞ？
どういうことだ？
Official English (Switch):
What...? I didn't feel any mana flowing
through that book when we left... Hm?
I can feel...a soul? What's going on?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
What...? No mana flowed
from it when we left... Hm? I
feel...a soul? What's going on?

Original Japanese (Vita):
だが、“人ならざる”お前と、
ルカが作る“魔女の人形兵”達で挑めば
必ずや攻略できよう。
Official English (Switch):
But you are not human, and with you and
Luca's puppet soldiers at our disposal,
I'm certain we can conquer it.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You're not human. With you and
Luca's puppet soldiers at our
disposal, we can conquer it.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ほう、是認か……
意外だな……だが、いい返事だ。

Oh, you consent...
I didn't expect that answer from you...
but it's a good answer nonetheless.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Oh, you agree? Surprising,
but a good answer.

Original Japanese (Vita):
いつの間にか、たまたま“本”に魂が宿った？
その魂が、都合よく私の味方となり
迷宮探索に尽力する？
Official English (Switch):
A book that happens to contain a soul?
And that book has agreed to explore the
labyrinth for me, no questions asked?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
A soul in a book? And it's
agreed to explore the labyrinth
for me, no questions asked?

Original Japanese (Vita):
私には他者のマナの動きがみえる。
そして、それを操作することで、
魂の選択を……すなわち“意思”を操れるんだ。
Official English (Switch):
I can sense the flow of mana within others.
By manipulating that flow, I can enthrall
souls to carry out my bidding.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I can sense mana in others.
By controlling that flow, I
can bend souls to my will.

Original Japanese (Vita):
破壊欲だろうが、収集欲だろうが、
地下では、欲望のままに暴れるがいい。
全て不問だ。
Official English (Switch):
Whether you lust for destruction or riches,
you're free to indulge either desire when
you're beneath the ground.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Lust for destruction or
riches? You're free to indulge
either desire underground.

Original Japanese (Vita):
……まあ……確かにな。
妖路歴程は一冊しかないんだ、
用心するにこしたことはないかもな。
Official English (Switch):
Well...that's certainly possible. And we
only have one Tractatus de Monstrum.
No harm in being cautious, I suppose.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Well...that's possible. We only
have one Tractatus de Monstrum.
No harm in being cautious.

Original Japanese (Vita):
レキテイは、レキテイスキル“黄ノ瘴気無効化”
を習得した！　これで、瘴気のダメージを
受けずに探索が行える。これはすごいことだ！
Official English (Switch):
You learned the Tractie Skill, "Yellow Miasma
Null"! Now you can explore without being
damaged by the miasma! Incredible!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Learned Tractie Skill: Yellow
Miasma Null! Explore without
miasma damage! Incredible!

Original Japanese (Vita):
よし、これで多少の瘴気は払えるはずだ。
ま、お前にはあまり関係ないはずなのだが……。
あくまで用心のためだ。
Official English (Switch):
Now you can pass through most of the miasma. 
It probably wouldn't affect you anyway, but
it doesn't hurt to take precautions.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You can pass most miasma.
It likely wouldn't affect you,
but precautions don't hurt.

Original Japanese (Vita):
なるほどな……妖路歴程が探索を行うと、
その情報が黒塗りのページに書き込まれていく……
この本、こういうからくりだったか。
Official English (Switch):
I see... While the Tractatus de Monstrum
is exploring, its findings are recorded on
a blackened page. Good to know.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I see... Tractatus de Monstrum
records its findings on a
blackened page as it explores.

Original Japanese (Vita):
妖路歴程から、地下で手に入れた各種の物品が
魔法のように顕現する。
Official English (Switch):
The various items that the Tractatus de
Monstrum obtained begin to materialize into
existence, as if by magic.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The items Tractatus de Monstrum
obtained begin to materialize
into existence, as if by magic.

Original Japanese (Vita):
それにしても……これがルフランの地下迷宮に
秘められし品々か……。
どれもこの世界ではありえない物ばかりだな。
Official English (Switch):
So these are some of the treasures the
labyrinth contains... These items could
not possibly be products of this world.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
So these are the labyrinth's
treasures... These items
could not be from this world.

Original Japanese (Vita):
これはご挨拶が遅れまして申し訳ございません。
どちらにお住まいか存じ上げなかったもので……。
よければ、案内して頂けませんでしょうか？
Official English (Switch):
I apologize for not visiting sooner.
I did not know where your master resides...
May I ask you to escort me?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Forgive my late visit. I didn't
know your master's address...
Could you escort me?

おっと、お客人にする話ではありませんでしたね。

Oh, I should not say such things to a guest.
This, in fact, is my master's finest shop.
I do hope you'll shop here during your stay.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I shouldn't say that to a guest!
His finest shop is here. Do
shop here during your stay.

此度は、ご依頼ありがとうございます。
私がバーバ・ヤーガ、こちらが弟子のルカ。

Official English (Switch):
Thank you for summoning me. I am Baba

I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Thanks for calling. I'm
Baba Yaga; this is Luca,
my apprentice. A pleasure.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ペトローネ様、お客人に失礼でございます。
そもそも強い魔力を持つ魔女ほど

Master Petrone, that is a rude question.

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Master Petrone, that's rude.
Powerful witches can look
as young as they wish.

公式に挑んだ者だけで、すでに５６８人の命が

Official English (Switch):
568 people are recorded as having died

Records list 568 labyrinth deaths, but

Original Japanese (Vita):
しかし、そんな中ただひとり、迷宮の奥底まで

The only man to reach the bottom of the

it compelled him to write a book...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
One man reached the
bottom. Its horrible secret
made him write a book...

ふむ……質は良いようですが……

Hmm, well, heh heh... This gold appears to

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Heh heh... Fine gold! Worth about
1,000 ciel silver coins, I'd say!

フ、フフフ……ご冗談が御上手で。

少なくとも銀貨６０００枚は下りません。
Official English (Switch):
Hmhmhm... Surely you jest. This is the

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Hmhmhm... You jest! This
is Haltz Kingdom currency,
worth at least 6,000!

オホン、お話中失礼――。
クラウスさん、お水を一杯頂けないでしょうか？

Official English (Switch):
*cough, cough* Pardon me... Klaus, may
I have a glass of water? My throat is

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
*cough, cough* Pardon me,
Klaus. Water, please? My
journey left me parched.

それから、この街に滞在中は税を免除して頂きたい。
なに、そこのマロニエが花咲く頃には

I will fulfill your request and leave Refrain

be prudent if I could avoid paying taxes.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I'll comply and leave before the conker

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Our town is poor. Yet have

Look, I think you have the wrong idea,

マリエッタは服をはだけると眼帯をはずした。

Hmph, it doesn't matter. I figured something

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Hmph. I expected something like this

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Marietta sheds her habit,
clasps her hands and offers

いやですわ、ドロニア様。

Why, such talk in public will only lead

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):

Dronya snatches up the Campanula Document and

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):

Dronya pours some droplets of a

A flash of anguish crosses Marietta's

オオガラスの……の中に小部屋……

机の引き出しや物置の中を

Even after searching every drawer, cupboard

Dronya searches every drawer,

この街で迎え撃つ……？　各個撃破……？　無理だ。

Should I ambush them? Take them out one at a

Ambush them one by one?
No! Once one arrives,

もし、７日後までに最後の１本を見つけられれば、

Find the last key in seven days.

鍵なんて全部バーバ様にあげちゃって

Why care for a brat like

Once I find all the keys and achieve my

Don't get used to this. Once I have

Baba would have found the key if I had

Baba would've found the key if I'd

In the same way Luca used that artifact to

Luca used a relic to enter my

Now, Tractie, listen carefully...
Since you'll be in a realm that is linked to

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Listen, Tractie. In this realm tied to

目的地は、精神世界の最奥だ。

You must reach the end of the mental space.
If you encounter my memories along the way,

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Reach the end of my mind's realm. If

English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
