むうぅ～～～～ん！！！　ふひっ♪
Official English (Switch):
Hahhhh... Hahhhh... Hahhhh...
Let's take off your arm next...
Hnghhhhhh!!! Heh heh! Heh heh heh heh!♪
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Hah... Your arm next...
Hngh! Heh heh heh!♪

Original Japanese (Vita):
ドロニアの腕は限界を超えて、ねじられると
魔法が解けたのか、球体関節の人形素体のような
ものになり体から外れた……。
Official English (Switch):
Nemto ripped Dronya's arm from its socket.
The arm, now cut off from Dronya's magic,
transformed into an articulated doll limb...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Nemto tears Dronya's arm
free. Without her magic,
it becomes a doll's limb.

Original Japanese (Vita):
こんなになっても生きている……ああ……
なんて、素晴らしいんだ……あぁ、食べちゃいたい、
食べちゃいたい、むちゃくちゃに壊したい！
Official English (Switch):
Still alive, even like this... Hahhh...
Amazing... Hahhh... I wanna tear you apart.
I wanna eat you up. Gobble you right up!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Still alive... Amazing... I wanna rip
you up and eat you, dolly! Gobble!

Original Japanese (Vita):
やっと、はぁ……はぁ……やっと見つけたんだ、
オデの理想の人を……人形を、ふひひひ！
はぁ……なんて美しいんだ、なんて美しいんだ……♪
Official English (Switch):
Finally... Hahhh... Hahhh... I finally found
it... The perfect dolly...for me... Heh heh!
She's...beautiful. So beautiful...♪
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
At last... My perfect dolly...
Beautiful, so beautiful!♪ Heh heh...

Original Japanese (Vita):
すん……すん……良い匂いで、
柔らかくて……はぁ……硬くて、ふひひ
……はぁ……はぁ……。
Official English (Switch):
*sniff, sniff* Smells so good... Hahhh...
This part's soft... This part's hard...
Hee hee hee.... Heh heh...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
*sniff* Smells so good... Soft
here, hard there... Hee hee...

Original Japanese (Vita):
ニムトがネルドの首を締め上げると
コキンという音とともに、ネルドは動かなくなった。
Official English (Switch):
Neldo struggled as Nemto wrapped his hands
around his neck. There was a loud snap, and
Neldo ceased his struggling.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Nemto grips Neldo's throat. A snap
sounds, and Neldo stops struggling.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ぶつぶつと何かを呟くドロニア。その瞳には既に
光がなく、正気を失っているようだった。
Official English (Switch):
Dronya was mumbling nonsense. The light was
vanishing from her eyes as her consciousness
began to slowly fade.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Dronya babbles as her eyes grow
dim and consciousness fades.

Original Japanese (Vita):
たしかに、私の腕力でこいつを使うのは無理だ。
なにせ私はナイフより重い得物は
持ったことがない……。
Official English (Switch):
Very well. I'm not strong enough to use
this anyway. There's only one weapon
light enough for me to wield...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Fine. I'm too weak for that. Only
one weapon is light enough for me...

Original Japanese (Vita):
はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……。
ふふふ……お前に魔力を与えすぎたか……
この程度で息が上がるとは――っ！
Official English (Switch):
Hahhhh... Hahhhh... Hahhhh... Heh, heh...
Looks like I gave you too much magic...
I'm already out of breath—AHH!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Hah... Heh... I gave you too much
magic... I'm out of breath―AHH!

Original Japanese (Vita):
ドロニアの足がもつれるが、ルカが小さな体で
それを支えた！
Official English (Switch):
Dronya's prothetic leg caught on the stone
pavement, but Luca used her small body to
keep Dronya from falling!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Dronya trips on her false leg, but
tiny Luca keeps her from falling!

Original Japanese (Vita):
私たちは……ルーラー魔法学校の
魔女は“鍵”のある迷宮を探すのが
本当の目的ですのよ。
Official English (Switch):
The true purpose of the witches produced
by the Ruler Magic Academy, is to find the
labyrinth that contains the keys.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Ruler Academy trains witches to
find labyrinths containing the keys.

Original Japanese (Vita):
そこで、魔女達は各地で仕官しながら、
その地域の情報を集め迷宮の存在を調査する……
これが、真の使命ですのよ。
Official English (Switch):
So we gain positions within governments
around the world, gather intelligence about
local labyrinths, and explore them...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
We take government posts
worldwide, gather labyrinth
intel and explore them.

Original Japanese (Vita):
そう……果て無き魔女学校での競争を勝ち抜いた
私が、ただの監視……監視……。
まさに、苦痛の日々でしたわ。
Official English (Switch):
Yes. I worked so hard to beat out the
competition at the academy, just to end
up an observer...  So frustrating...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I fought to beat my academy
rivals... only to become
a watcher. How vexing!

Original Japanese (Vita):
だから、遊んだんです、遊んであげたんです！
ほら、そう……ルカ様だって、
虫で遊ばれたことあるでしょう？
Official English (Switch):
I just wanted to have fun! That's why
I played with them... Oh, you've played
with bugs before, right Lady Luca?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
So I toyed with them! Lady
Luca, you've played with
insects too, haven't you?

Original Japanese (Vita):
私では、ルカ様にはかないませんので
口惜しいですが、ドロニア型の廃棄は
他の魔女達に譲るとしましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Unfortunately, I don't stand a chance against
you, so I'll let the other witches take care
of Dronya's disposal.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I can't beat Lady Luca, so I'll let
the other witches dispose of Dronya.

Original Japanese (Vita):
産後の肥立ちが悪く、何度も危篤状態に陥り、
そのたびに貴女に手紙を書いていたのですが……
１年前に。
Official English (Switch):
Her health took a turn for the worse after
Luca was born... But she wrote to you every
day, up until...one year ago.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
After giving birth she nearly died many
times and wrote you... A year ago.

Original Japanese (Vita):
なんだと！　私にそんな義理はない！
それに、イサラからどう聞いたか知らんが、
私はそんな人間でもない！
Official English (Switch):
What!? How dare you ask that of me!
I don't know what Isara told you about
me, but I'm not that kind of person!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
What!? I owe you nothing!
And whatever Isara said,
that's not who I am!

Original Japanese (Vita):
構いません……。
少しでも延命し、そしてあの子のそばに……
あなたのお役にわずかでも立てれば……。
Official English (Switch):
That's fine... I just want to stay by Luca's
side for as long as I can...until she can be
of use to you someday.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I don't mind... If I can live longer,
stay with her and help you a little...

Original Japanese (Vita):
普通ならとても長い修行が要る。
だけど、お前には母親から受け継いだ
“魂の魔女”としての偉大な力があるはずだ。
Official English (Switch):
Becoming a witch would normally require years
of training. But you have inherited the great
power of the Soul Witch from your mother.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Training takes years, but you inherited
your mother's Soul Witch power.

Original Japanese (Vita):
この人形にヴェルニアの魂を宿らせるのさ。
それができなきゃ、お前はずっと一人だ。
大好きな“おばちゃん”を生き返らせたいだろう？
Official English (Switch):
You wish to see your precious auntie
again, yes? Then you must put her soul
into this doll, or be alone. Forever.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Put Velnya's soul in this doll or be
alone forever. Want Auntie back?

Original Japanese (Vita):
さあ、どうする？　できないのかい？
なあに、イサラの血を引くお前なら簡単だ。
魂を入れ、そして新しい名前を付けるんだ。
Official English (Switch):
Do I sense hesitation? You are of Isara's
blood. Binding Velnya's soul to this doll
should be a trivial task for you.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
It's easy for Isara's child. Put her
soul in and give her a new name.

Original Japanese (Vita):
２つ鍵があれば、儀式はおそらくできる。
だが、それでは何が起きるかわからない……。
やはり、最後はレキテイにかけるしかない。
Official English (Switch):
With two keys, we can probably conduct the
ritual, but I don't know what might happen...
We'll just have to trust Tractie.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Two keys might work for the ritual,
but it's risky. We must trust Tractie.

Original Japanese (Vita):
だが、穢レ人がうろついているので
兵士を少し引かせているな……。
運よくもっても日の出まで……か。
Official English (Switch):
But with the unclean ones roaming the
streets, there aren't that many soldiers...
We have until sunrise, if we're lucky...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The Unclean Ones keep soldiers
back. With luck, we have until dawn.

Original Japanese (Vita):
おそらく最後の鍵はカンパニュラにあるはずだ。
ここまでの傾向を考えると、ありそうな場所に
あった鍵はすべて偽物……。
Official English (Switch):
The last key might be in Campanula.
In hindsight, all the places we thought
had keys turned out to be dead ends...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The last key is likely in Campanula. All
the obvious places had fake keys...

Original Japanese (Vita):
マリエッタ、このままだとお前もおそらく
引き込まれるぞ？　煉獄の住人が“あちら”に
いったらどうなるかはわからん。
Official English (Switch):
Marietta, you should leave too. I don't
know what will happen if a resident of
this purgatory crosses over with us.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Marietta, leave too. A
resident crossing from
purgatory may be in danger.

Original Japanese (Vita):
浅はかな女と思われるでしょう、ですが……、
あれさえなくなり、あなたがルフランの迷宮のことを
忘れられれば――
Official English (Switch):
I know it's silly but...I thought if I got
rid of that thing, and if you could somehow
forget about the labyrinth...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Silly, but I hoped destroying it might
make you forget the labyrinth...

Original Japanese (Vita):
ドロニア様……好きです。
美しく、気高く、自由をもとめて自分を貫かれた
あなたが。手を握ってくれたあの時から……。
Official English (Switch):
Madam Dronya... I love you. You're beautiful.
You're dignified. You value freedom above all
else. Ever since you held my hand, I...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Dronya, I love your beauty, pride and
freedom... Since you held my hand...

Original Japanese (Vita):
いや、柩から出た者はいた。
試練は受けられる。
だが、それに成功した者はいない。
Official English (Switch):
No, there was one person who emerged.
They then underwent a trial. A trial that
they failed. A trial that everyone fails.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
One soul escaped, then faced a
trial. It failed, as everyone does.

Original Japanese (Vita):
突然イサラが放った電撃がドロニアに落ちる。
たまらず膝をつくドロニア。鍵が床にこぼれ
落ち、そのひとつが砕け散った。
Official English (Switch):
Isara suddenly blasted Dronya with lightning.
She fell to the ground and dropped one of the
keys, which shattered upon impact.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Isara strikes Dronya with lightning. She
drops a key, which shatters below.

Original Japanese (Vita):
バーバ……っ！
迷宮を渡ってきた古の魔女……。
Official English (Switch):
It's you... The ancient witch who crossed
the labyrinth... The true author of the
Tractatus de Monstrum...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You... The ancient witch
who crossed the labyrinth,
author of the Tractatus...

Original Japanese (Vita):
妖路歴程の作者であり……
体を乗っ取りながら数多世界を渡り歩いてきた
伝説の魔女……厄の魔女フルーラ……お前か……！
Official English (Switch):
The witch who traveled across numerous worlds,
possessing new bodies along the way...
You're...Calamity Witch Furia!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The witch who crossed many worlds
and bodies... Calamity Witch Furia!

Original Japanese (Vita):
フルーラ？　……これは懐かしい名前がでたね。
まあ、あちこちの世界で見聞きすれば
出ないわけがない名前さ。
Official English (Switch):
Furia? That's a name I've not heard for
a long time. A name spoken only in hushed
whispers across countless worlds.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Furia? A name not spoken aloud
across countless worlds for ages.

Original Japanese (Vita):
イサラをお前らが殺しちまったもんで、
ルカの体を使おうかとも思ったが、
当初の予定通りイサラの体を奪えて良かったよ。
Official English (Switch):
After you killed Isara just now, I tried to
take Luca's body. Fortunately, I was still
able to make use of Isara's body.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I sought Luca after Isara died,
but Isara's body was still useful.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ひっひっひ、マリエッタは血のつながりで
抵抗されて手をやいたが、他人では無駄さ。
たとえイサラでもね。
Official English (Switch):
Hehehe... Controlling Mary was difficult for
me, but controlling Isara is no trouble, as she
and I are not blood-related.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Mary was hard to control, but Isara
isn't my blood, so she's easy.

Original Japanese (Vita):
バーバ・イサラは床に散らばった２つの鍵を
拾うと、マリエッタの体から鍵をひとつ取り
出して掲げ、柩に手を突っ込んだ。
Official English (Switch):
Baba Isara picks up the two keys on the floor,
retrieves a third key from Marietta's body, and
reaches her hand into the coffin.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Baba Isara takes two keys,
a third from Marietta, and
reaches into the coffin.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ち、地上に出る気だ……
バーバ・ヤーガは、これを、この時を、
何百年も待っていたというのか？
Official English (Switch):
Sh-She's attempting to go to the surface...
Baba Yaga... Have you been waiting for this
moment for hundreds of years?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Baba, heading for the surface... Was
that your plan all these centuries?

Original Japanese (Vita):
おばあちゃんを行かせてはダメ……
この世界……すべての世界を渡り歩く力こそが
オオガラスの力……不死、不死身の怪物。
Official English (Switch):
You can't let my grandmother escape...
Velkuvrana is...immortal... Undying...
It can even travel between worlds...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Don't let Grandma escape! Velkuvrana
can't die and can cross worlds...

Original Japanese (Vita):
行け、ルカ！　お前たちを信じている。
今や、お前は私より強い。逃げろとは言わない。
アイツを倒して、私を迎えに来い！
Official English (Switch):
Go, Luca! You're stronger than me now, so I
won't tell you to run. You're going to defeat
that thing and come back! I believe in you!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Go, Luca! You're stronger than me.
Beat it and return! I believe in you!

Original Japanese (Vita):
悪しき厄の魔女であり、また私の母でもある、
成体となったオオガラスのせいでね。
もう誰にも止められないんだよ……。
Official English (Switch):
The Calamity Witch possessed my mother to
become Velkuvrana, and it has fully matured.
It's unstoppable now...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Furia took Mother's body
as Velkuvrana. Now it's
mature and unbeatable...

Original Japanese (Vita):
あの不安定な場で子供の私が力を使えば、
私が召還しなくても、キミの意識、いや“魂”は
必ずこちらに飛ばされると思っていたよ。
Official English (Switch):
That's why your soul has been sent to me in
the future. Because she tried to use her time
magic in that unstable environment.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Your soul came to future me because
her time spell faltered in that turmoil.

Original Japanese (Vita):
……私はこの滅びた未来の中で、
時間に干渉する術を見つけたんだ。
そして、過去に賭けた。
Official English (Switch):
In this shattered future, I gained the ability
to interfere with time, and I used that ability
to set up a gambit in the past.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
In this ruined future, I
gained time magic and set a
plan in motion in the past.

Original Japanese (Vita):
本来の姿に近かったんだ。だから、ネルドは
自分の力で人間の姿になることができた。
まあ、彼は戦闘要員と思ってもらっていいさ。
Official English (Switch):
Since it was closest to his original form, he
was able to transform into a human, too.
He basically acted as your combat support.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
In a form close to his own, he became
human and supported you in combat.

Original Japanese (Vita):
もう１つはヌッタマッタ。
彼は少し特殊で、“本人の体”に
“本人の魂”を送った。
Official English (Switch):
The other soul was Newton's, or Newt as you
know him. He was a special case, as I was able
to put his soul in his original body.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The next soul was Newton's, or
Newt's. I sent it to his former body.

Original Japanese (Vita):
彼は最高クラスの魔術を操る大賢者でね。
ネルドがその“ナニカ”を見つけたら
その情報を未来に送り返すのが役目だ。
Official English (Switch):
He is a Great Sage and a powerful magic-user.
Once Neldo found what he was after, Newton's
role was to send it to the future.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Newt is a Great Sage. Once Neldo
found it, Newt had to send it here.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ただ、そのための魔力を残すと
バーバに気取られる可能性があったから、
自ら記憶を消したんだ。
Official English (Switch):
But he knew Baba would detect his magic if
he used it, so he sealed his memories away
and assumed a new identity.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Newt hid his magic from
Baba by sealing his memories
and changing names.

Original Japanese (Vita):
わかるだろ？　こんな勝算の低い賭けに、
みんな命を懸けたんだ。
でも、それはすべて絶望の裏返しさ……。
Official English (Switch):
Do you get it now? Despite the low chance of
success, everyone agreed to risk their lives.
In a way, it's like the opposite of despair...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The odds were slim, but
everyone risked their lives.
The opposite of despair...

Original Japanese (Vita):
私たちが長年かけて見つけた、
オオガラスを倒す唯一のキーワードが
“<player_name>”だった。
Official English (Switch):
We spent many years searching for the
name that can defeat Velkuvrana, and it
turned out to be <player_name>.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
We spent years seeking the
name to beat Velkuvrana.
It was <player_name>.

Original Japanese (Vita):
キミを最初からこちらに召喚していれば
よかったのか。そもそもそんなことは不可能
だったのか……今となってはもう分からない。
Official English (Switch):
Maybe I should have summoned you here from
the start. Maybe that was impossible for me
to do... I don't even know anymore.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Perhaps I should've called you first.
Maybe I couldn't. I don't know.

Original Japanese (Vita):
オオガラスが孵ったのはまだいい。
でも成体にしては絶対にいけない。
そんなことが可能なのかわからない。
Official English (Switch):
As impossible as it sounds, as long as the
newly hatched Velkuvrana doesn't reach full
maturity, you still have a chance.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
As long as young Velkuvrana
doesn't mature, you have a chance.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ひとついっておくとね、過去が助かっても
未来には影響がないんだ。
まったく別の“滅亡しない世界”ができるだけだ。
Official English (Switch):
One last thing... Even if you save the past, it
won't change this future. It will just create a
future that wasn't ruined.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Even if you save the past,
this future stays. You'll
create a new, safe future.

Original Japanese (Vita):
意味がないように思うかもしれないけど、でも……。
せめて、過去だけでも助かってほしいんだよ……
だって……だって、悔しいじゃない！
Official English (Switch):
You might think this is all for nothing, but...
I just want to save the past because...I won't
forgive myself if I don't!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
It may seem pointless, but I must save
the past or I'll never forgive myself!

Original Japanese (Vita):
こちらの私が死んだらもうダメなんだ。
使えなくなる。
繰り返す過去の世界が消えてしまうからさ。
Official English (Switch):
Because...my death will cause all the recurring
versions of the past to disappear, and there
will be no way to undo it.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
My death would erase every recurring
past. We couldn't undo that.

Original Japanese (Vita):
あと、私がこう言うのも変だけど、子供のルカも
よろしく頼むよ。私と彼女はまったく異なる
人生を生きた、別人みたいなものなんだ。
Official English (Switch):
It might seem strange for me to say this, but
please take care of Luca. She could not be
more different from me.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
It sounds odd, but protect young
Luca. She's so different from me.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ルカさん……幼体とはいえ、
オオガラスが孵ってしまった以上
もうここは――
Official English (Switch):
Luca... Velkuvrana may be newly born, but now
that it's hatched, there's nothing we can do.
This place is—
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Luca... Even though it's
young, now that Velkuvrana
has hatched, this place―

Original Japanese (Vita):
……街の結界はまだ破られていません。
レキテーちゃんの記録通りなら、
オオガラスを倒すチャンスは……
Official English (Switch):
...The ward around the town is still up.
If Tractie's memories are right, then we
still have a chance to beat it...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The ward holds. Tractie's notes
say we may still beat Velkuvrana...

Original Japanese (Vita):
でも、パンを焼いていればあたしは幸せ。
あの人がおいしいと笑ってくれるのは密かな自慢。
Official English (Switch):
I only felt happy when I was baking bread.
I would secretly feel proud whenever someone
said my bread tasted good.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Baking bread made me
happy. I was secretly proud
when people liked my bread.

Original Japanese (Vita):
カラザの井戸のある壊れたガゼボの中から、
バーバの声が聞こえる。
Official English (Switch):
From the shattered rotunda, Baba Yaga's voice
is heard bellowing all the way from the bottom
of the Well of Khalaza.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Baba Yaga's voice booms
from the shattered rotunda at
the bottom of Khalaza's Well.

Original Japanese (Vita):
もともと生物ではないオオガラス。
それを生き返らせるには、媒体となる肉体が必要
だったんだ。
Official English (Switch):
Velkuvrana is not a flesh-and-blood creature.
It can be revived, but to do so requires a
physical body to act as a medium.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Velkuvrana has no flesh. To
revive it, a physical body
must serve as its vessel.

Original Japanese (Vita):
だから、アタシはその力を引き継いだ娘……
ルカ、お前を媒介にしてオオガラスを蘇らせ、
こいつを孵化させようと考えたんだよ。
Official English (Switch):
But you, Luca, inherited your mother's power.
So I was prepared to use you as the medium, 
and revive Velkuvrana so that it could hatch.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Luca, you got your mother's power. I
meant to use you to hatch Velkuvrana.

Original Japanese (Vita):
妖路歴程を書いた男ってのは作り話さ……。
聞いてないのかい？
Official English (Switch):
The Tractatus de Monstrum, written by the
one man to escape the labyrinth of Refrain...
You did not know that was a made-up story?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The Tractatus, supposedly written by a
man who fled Refrain? That was a lie.

Original Japanese (Vita):
各世界は、小部屋でつなぎ、
移動には妖路歴程が必要になる。
Official English (Switch):
I created antechambers to link the different
worlds, and the Tractatus de Monstrum was the
key I created to travel between them.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I linked worlds with antechambers
and made the Tractatus
to travel among them.

Original Japanese (Vita):
あの、世界に干渉できるフクロウの一族……
世界樹の一族は覚えているよ。
Official English (Switch):
I have not forgotten the denizens of Yggdrasil.
Those intrusive owls who fly between the
boundaries of time and space.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I still remember Yggdrasil's folk,
those owls who cross time and space.

Original Japanese (Vita):
あの力は邪魔だからね。
世界をつぶして滅ぼしたはずだったんだけど
まあ、今となってはどうでもいいさね。
Official English (Switch):
Their power posed a threat to my plan, so
I destroyed their world. Now they are but
a footnote in my rise to power.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Their power threatened my
plan, so I destroyed their
world. They're history now.

Original Japanese (Vita):
さあ……おしゃべりはしまいだ。
オオガラスをここで成体にして、不死の体、
不老の魂ですべてを喰らい尽くしてやるよ！
Official English (Switch):
But enough talk. Once Velkuvrana reaches
maturity, I will merge with its eternal body
and soul, and devour all of existence!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Once Velkuvrana matures, I'll
merge with its immortal body
and soul and devour all!

Original Japanese (Vita):
なっ……バカな……バカなぁっ！
すべてを喰らい尽くす、このオオガラスが……
こんな小娘ごときに！　人形ごときに……！！
Official English (Switch):
What... No... It can't be!
Velkuvrana... The great devourer...
Defeated by a little girl!? And her dolls!?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
No! Impossible! Velkuvrana,
the great devourer, beaten
by a girl and her dolls!?

Original Japanese (Vita):
ああ、ルカ！　ルカぁっ！
お前、育ててやった恩を忘れて、なんてことを……！
なんてことをしてくれたんだい！
Official English (Switch):
Ahhh! Luca! What have you done!?
Have you forgotten who raised you, child!?
How could you do this to me!?!?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Luca! What have you done!? I raised
you! How could you betray me!?

Original Japanese (Vita):
崩れていく……オオガラスが……
アタシの体が……！　１０００年の夢が！
不死の肉体が……永久の命が……！
Official English (Switch):
I waited 1,000 years for this!
Velkuvrana... Immortality... Life eternal...
It's...crumbling around me...!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I waited a thousand years!
Velkuvrana... Immortality...
My eternal life is crumbling!

Original Japanese (Vita):
その刹那、フクロウが音もなく滑空してくると
人の姿に変わり、オオガラスの心臓に剣をつきたてた！
Official English (Switch):
An owl soared down from the sky, transformed
into a familiar-looking young man, and plunged
his sword into Velkuvrana's heart!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
An owl swoops down, becomes a man
and stabs the giant raven's heart!

Original Japanese (Vita):
オオガラスの肉体は崩れ去り、バーバもまた
その長い命を終えた。そして、後に残された
塵の中から、３本の鍵が見つかった。
Official English (Switch):
Velkuvrana crumbled into dust, and Baba Yaga's
long life finally came to an end. The three
keys were all that remained.

Original Japanese (Vita):
はぁ……どこからその自信がでてくるのか
聞きたいものだ。
お前は単純だからすぐに振り向くだろ……。
Official English (Switch):
*sigh* Where do you get your confidence?
A little idiot like you will probably look
back and not think twice about it...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
*sigh* So confident! An idiot like you
would look back without even thinking.

Original Japanese (Vita):
娘が毎晩お前の話をせがむんだ。
前の手紙に書いたが……いやその前かな。
ワタシにはちっとも似ていないらしいワタシの子だ。
Official English (Switch):
My daughter won't stop asking about you.
I think I mentioned that in my last letter...
No, maybe the one before.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
My daughter keeps asking
about you. I told you last
letter... Or was it earlier?

Original Japanese (Vita):
でも、触るとわかる。この子は美人だ。
きっとお前も驚くぞ？
Official English (Switch):
But I can tell how beautiful she is, just
by touching her. I know she'll surprise you
when you finally meet her.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I can tell she's beautiful
just by touch. You'll be
amazed when you meet her.

Original Japanese (Vita):
悪しき者を遠ざける記憶の戒めよ、
その役目を終え、奥底に眠る在りし日々を
再び取り戻さん……。
Official English (Switch):
Thy role is finished, now awaken thine
sealed memories, where evil fears to tread,
and reclaim thine days gone by...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Thy duty is done. Awaken
thy sealed memories and
reclaim the days lost to evil.

Original Japanese (Vita):
エヘヘ……どんな答えでも、前向きに
とるのが、ルカのいいところ……
いいところなんですから！
Official English (Switch):
Hehehe... No matter what you say, I'm gonna
stay positive... That's what makes me Luca!
I'm always positive, no matter what!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Hehehe... I'll stay positive! That's
who I am, Luca! No matter what!

Original Japanese (Vita):
妖路歴程が光り輝くとその頁はバラバラになり
残った紫の粒子は天高くへ上っていくと、
そのまま透けるように消えた。
Official English (Switch):
The Tractatus de Monstrum glows brilliantly
as it ascends into the heavens, where it
dissolves into violet specks of light.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The Tractatus rises, shining
brightly, then scatters
into violet flecks of light.

Original Japanese (Vita):
イサラには勇気があった。
強い者に立ち向かうことだけが勇気じゃない。
境遇や運命に立ち向かうのも勇気だ。
Official English (Switch):
Isara knew what it meant to have courage.
She had the courage to face those stronger
than her, and the courage to face her fate.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Isara knew courage: to face stronger
foes, and to face her fate.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ああ、そうだな……でも、治らないから努力しない？
勝てないから全力で戦わない？
そういうことか？
Official English (Switch):
True, but...is that why you won't try?
Because it won't heal? You won't try your
hardest because you can't win? Is that it?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
So you won't try because
you can't heal? You won't
fight hard if you can't win?

Original Japanese (Vita):
……宗教でもはじめるつもりか？
それに、鑑賞者がいないギャラリーなんて無意味だ。
Official English (Switch):
...Are you starting a cult or something?
Besides, there's no point in displaying your
soul if nobody's looking.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Are you starting a cult?
And why reveal your soul if
no one's there to see it?

Original Japanese (Vita):
夫は……いやメディニラは意外と優しいんだぞ？
まあ、言うなればワタシの召使いみたいなもんだ。
ここの生活も、思ったより悪くないよ。
Official English (Switch):
Medinilla... He's actually a pretty nice guy.
He's more like my servant than my husband, but
otherwise being his wife isn't so bad.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Medinilla's nice. He's more
servant than husband,
but being his wife is fine.

Original Japanese (Vita):
庭は一面の白薔薇らしい。目が見えるように
なったときの為にだってさ。笑っちゃうよな。
今年も綺麗に咲いたそうだ……。
Official English (Switch):
He filled the garden with white roses, in
case my vision returns. He's a funny man.
I'm sure they bloomed lovely this year...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
He planted white roses in
case I see again. Funny
man... They must look lovely.

Original Japanese (Vita):
……ルカ、私は……
私は、明日には王宮に帰らないといけない。
最後に、ここを見せたかった……。
Official English (Switch):
Luca, I brought you here because...I have to
return to the royal court tomorrow. I wanted
to show you this place before I left...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Luca, I wanted to show
you this before I return to
the royal court tomorrow.

Original Japanese (Vita):
でもね、人形に魂を込めたところで
それは本物とは違う、かりそめの命。
いつかは消えゆく、玩具の命さね。
Official English (Switch):
But putting a soul into a poppet is not
a true resurrection... Like a wind-up toy,
she will eventually stop moving one day.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
A soul in a poppet isn't revival. Like
a wound-up toy, it will stop one day.

Original Japanese (Vita):
月明かりがみえれば
去らねばならない、刹那の命だ。
……なにも後悔はない。
Official English (Switch):
But now the moonlight has come, and
my brief life has finally reached its end.
This is goodbye, but I have no regrets...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The moonlight is here. My short life is
over. Goodbye... I have no regrets.

Original Japanese (Vita):
妖路歴程が光り輝くとその頁はバラバラになり
霧散していった。
Official English (Switch):
The Tractatus de Monstrum glowed brilliantly
as each of its pages began to tear themselves
out, one by one, and vanish.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The Tractatus glows as its pages tear
free, one by one, and disappear.

Original Japanese (Vita):
あーあ、まずっちゃったな。
それに、もう魔力も残り少ないや……。
もうだめか、くそーくやしいなー。
Official English (Switch):
Oh no, did I screw up? I think I screwed up...
I don't have enough magic either...
I guess this is the end. Damn it...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Oh no, I botched it! And I'm low on
magic... So this is the end. Damn...

Original Japanese (Vita):
大勢の仲間が死んだ……。
人が死んだ。
……国が滅びた。
Official English (Switch):
This country has been completely destroyed.
Countless innocents have died...and many of
my allies have fallen...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Our country is gone. Innumerable
innocents and my allies are dead...

Original Japanese (Vita):
１０００年、いや、１００年でいい。
研究の時間さえ稼げれば打つ手はきっとある。
Official English (Switch):
Whether it's 1,000 years or 100 years, as
long as we buy ourselves some time to study
it, I'm sure we can eventually defeat it.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
A hundred or a thousand
years―any time to study
it might let us defeat it.

Original Japanese (Vita):
心臓を止めても、おそらくすぐに再生が始まる。
だから、殺すのは無理。
Official English (Switch):
Even with its heart stopped, Velkuvrana
can still regenerate itself. That's why
killing it outright is impossible.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Velkuvrana heals itself even if its
heart stops. We can't kill it outright.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ふふーん、ちなみに“人類ほぼ滅亡”の
この世界で生き残っている私の最大の取り柄は、
すっごい前向きなところだからね！
Official English (Switch):
Hmhm! I managed to survive in this world
where humanity is nearly wiped out, so I'm
very optimistic about our chances!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Hmhm! I survived a world with few
humans left. Our odds look great!

Original Japanese (Vita):
そう、ここはルフランの地下迷宮と何ら変わらない
巨大な迷宮で、強力なエネミーが巣くってる……
つまり、難攻不落のダンジョンってことさ。
Official English (Switch):
A sprawling labyrinth filled with deadly
monsters, just like the one beneath Refrain...
Except this one's way more fortified.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
It's a vast monster-filled maze like
Refrain's, but even more fortified.

Original Japanese (Vita):
彼女たちはそれぞれ、敵を攪乱しながら、
オオガラスの心臓を目指して進撃している
はず……なんだけど。
Official English (Switch):
They're distracting the enemies as they make
their way toward Velkuvrana's heart... At
least, that's what's supposed to be happening.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
They're drawing foes away as they
head for the heart... In theory.

Original Japanese (Vita):
でも、私はマロニエ作戦でキミを召喚することに
成功したから、急遽、単独作戦に移行することに
したよ……。たった今、ね。
Official English (Switch):
Since I was able to bring you back, I've just
decided we can proceed with Operation Conker,
and carry out a solo mission.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Since you're back, we'll carry
out Operation Conker on our own.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ヌッタの予言では、“<player_name>”が
オオガラスを倒すキーになるって話だった。
Official English (Switch):
According to Newton's prophecy, the key
to defeating Velkuvrana is "<player_name>."
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Newton's prophecy says
Velkuvrana's defeat
hinges on <player_name>.

Original Japanese (Vita):
おそらく、“<player_name>”の力なしでは、
オオガラスの心臓を止め、封じることは
できないってことなんだと思う。
Official English (Switch):
I think that means we can't stop Velkuvrana's
heart and seal it without <player_name>'s help.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
So without <player_name>,
we can't stop its
heart and seal it.

Original Japanese (Vita):
この作戦では、心臓ではなくて、
この迷宮のどこかにある“小部屋”を探す。
Official English (Switch):
For this plan, we're not gonna look for
the heart. Instead, we're gonna search
this labyrinth for the antechambers.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
We won't seek the heart. We'll search
this labyrinth for antechambers.

Original Japanese (Vita):
あと、これは伝えとかなきゃなんだけどさ
敵にも相当ヤバイのがいるんだ……。
キミもよく知っている魔女の姿――
Official English (Switch):
Also, I need to tell you one last thing.
There's a dangerous enemy in here.
Someone who you might recognize—
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
One last warning: there's a dangerous
enemy here you might know―

Original Japanese (Vita):
ドロニアの姿をした敵が無造作に放ったそれは、
迷宮の床に落ちて転がった。人の首――その顔に
マズルカは見覚えがあった。
Official English (Switch):
The enemy resembling Dronya casually tossed
a human head onto the floor of the labyrinth...
A head that Mezzaluca recognized.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
A Dronya-like foe casually throws a
human head down. Mezzaluca knows it.

Original Japanese (Vita):
（へん……片道切符は承知の上だよ。
それに、その顔で好き勝手に
ベラベラしゃべってんじゃないっての……。）
Official English (Switch):
(Hmph... You think you can run your mouth
while you wear her face? You think I don't
already know this is a one-way trip?)
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
(You dare mock me with her face?
I know this is a one-way trip!)

Original Japanese (Vita):
……仲間の亡骸を見せたのは逆効果だったか。
もうちょっと、気概のある魔女と思っていたが。
とんだ臆病者だったな。
Official English (Switch):
...I thought you stronger than this, witch.
I thought your comrade's folly would inspire
you to action, not cowardice. What a shame.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I expected strength, witch. Your
ally's folly bred fear, not courage.

Original Japanese (Vita):
敵は果てしなく強大だ。
オオガラスの心臓どころか、迷宮内の連中すら
恐ろしい力を持っている。
Official English (Switch):
The enemies here are relentless.
Even the ones in the labyrinth, far from
Velkuvrana's heart, have deadly powers.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Foes here are relentless. Even far from
the heart, they have deadly powers.

Original Japanese (Vita):
私たちじゃ勝てない敵もいるかもしれない……。
キミたち旅団の力も、培った経験すらも
通用しないかもしれない……。
Official English (Switch):
Even with the power of your brigade and all
the experience you've obtained, that still
might not be enough to stop them...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Your experienced brigade may still
be too weak to stop them...

Original Japanese (Vita):
“<player_name>”！　キミが頼りだ！
待ってろよ、オオガラス！
さあ！　いざ迷宮を攻略せん！
Official English (Switch):
<player_name>! I'm counting on you!
You better watch out, Velkuvrana!
Because we're gonna conquer this labyrinth!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
<player_name>, I count
on you! Velkuvrana, we
will conquer this maze!

Original Japanese (Vita):
小部屋は結界で守られていた。
マズルカはその紋章から誰がこの部屋を攻略したのか
知ることができた。
Official English (Switch):
The antechamber is protected by a ward.
Mezzaluca looks at the crest on the ward
to find out who secured this room.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
A ward guards the room. Mezzaluca
reads its crest to identify the caster.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ま、待て……私を……
私を忘れたの……か……マズルカ……
一緒に、あの丘で……。
Official English (Switch):
Wh-What about me...Mezzaluca?
Have you forgotten...about me?
Remember...when we went...to the hill...?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
What about me, Mezzaluca? Remember
the hill we visited together...?

Original Japanese (Vita):
いけないいけない、泣いてる場合じゃなかった。
あいつはああ言ったけど、他のみんなが
やられたって決まったわけじゃない。
Official English (Switch):
This is no time for tears. She may have
called me the last witch, but I don't know
for certain that the others were defeated.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
No tears. She called me
the last witch, but I don't
know if the rest are dead.

Original Japanese (Vita):
成体になったオオガラス本体は、キミが知っている
ものよりはるかに巨大なんだ。
で、その内部は迷宮になっている。こんな風にね。
Official English (Switch):
The fully matured Velkuvrana is way bigger
than the one you remember. That's why this
enormous labyrinth can fit inside of it.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Mature Velkuvrana is huge; its
body holds this whole labyrinth.

Original Japanese (Vita):
バーバとカカ様の力でドロニア型に似せた化身を
作り出し、それを大量に送り込んできているんだ。
Official English (Switch):
Using Baba and Mom's power, Velkuvrana
manifested a legion of Dronya poppets and sent
them inside itself.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
With Baba and Mom's power,
Velkuvrana made an army
of Dronya dolls inside it.

Original Japanese (Vita):
見ての通りドロニア様にそっくりの容姿と記憶――
でもあいつらに人の心なんてない……。
どんなにそう見えようともね。
Official English (Switch):
They may have Madam Dronya's appearance and
memories...but no matter how real they appear,
they don't have a human soul at all.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
They look and remember like Dronya,
but none has a human soul.

Original Japanese (Vita):
各魔女は、別々の場所から迷宮に侵入して
８箇所から同時に進撃、オオガラスを
攪乱しつつ心臓を目指す。
Official English (Switch):
We entered from different areas before we
launched our attack. Our goal was to distract
Velkuvrana as we made our way to its heart.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
We entered separately to distract
it while we sought its heart.

Original Japanese (Vita):
これまで４度のアタックを試みた。
けど、仲間はそのつど半分になっていき、
そして結局心臓の部屋は見つけられなかった……。
Official English (Switch):
We've launched four attacks so far. With each
attack, more Great Witches have died and we've
gotten no closer to reaching the heart...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Four attacks, more witches
dead each time, and still
no closer to its heart...

Original Japanese (Vita):
オオガラスはもう成体になってる。
あとは飛び立ちこの世界を外側から喰らうだけ。
いつ飛び立ってもおかしくない状況だ。
Official English (Switch):
Velkuvrana has already reached full maturity.
At a moment's notice, it could take to the sky
and devour this world.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Mature Velkuvrana could fly up and
devour the world at any moment.

Original Japanese (Vita):
８つの小部屋全てでこの儀式を行えば
オオガラスはその多次元で構成された体を保てず
内部の結界は崩壊する！
Official English (Switch):
If we conduct the ritual in each antechamber,
the witch's crest holding Velkuvrana's body
together will become unstable!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Each antechamber ritual weakens the
crests holding Velkuvrana together!

Original Japanese (Vita):
その間にも戦いは激しくなる一方で、
ある者は諦め、ある者は戦いに散り、
絶望のあまり自ら死を選ぶ者すらいた。
Official English (Switch):
As the battle intensified, some gave up,
others ran away, and some killed themselves
rather than live with the horror.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
As war raged, some fled, some quit,
and some chose death over the horror.

Original Japanese (Vita):
予言で出たその言葉を解明し手に入れるために、
ネルドとヌッタは過去に飛んだんだ。
魂だけ……ね。
Official English (Switch):
They allowed their souls to be sent to the
past, so they could obtain the source of the
name mentioned in the prophecy.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
They sent their souls to the past to
find the source of the foretold name.

Original Japanese (Vita):
その直後に、私が“彷徨える魂”と干渉して
解ったのがキミの名前、キミの存在ってわけ。
Official English (Switch):
Not long after, I used my ability to sense
wandering souls, and discovered that your name
is the true name of the Tractatus de Monstrum.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I sensed wandering souls
and learned your name was
the Tractatus's true name.

Original Japanese (Vita):
この世界の妖路歴程は失われていたけど、
妖路歴程の真名がキミの名だとわかったとき、
あるひとつの事実が浮かび上がった。
Official English (Switch):
Though that book no longer exists in this
world, learning its true name allowed me to
make an important discovery.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The book is gone here, but its true
name let me discover something vital.

Original Japanese (Vita):
今にして思えば、私たちが起動させられるのか、
“小部屋”の秘密を知っているのかを
見定めていたんだと思う。
Official English (Switch):
In hindsight, I think she was testing whether
we knew the secret of the antechamber, and if
we were capable of activating it.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
In hindsight, she was testing if we
knew and could activate the chamber.

Original Japanese (Vita):
でも、妖路歴程の真名がキミの名だと
知ったとき、気がついたんだ。
Official English (Switch):
But when I learned that you were the true
name of the Tractatus de Monstrum, that's
when everything finally made sense.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
When I learned your name was the
Tractatus's true name, it all clicked.

Original Japanese (Vita):
部屋はキミがいれば繋がるんだ。なにせ
小部屋と小部屋を、世界と世界が繋がるように
バーバ自身が作ったのが妖路歴程なんだからね。
Official English (Switch):
She created the Tractatus de Monstrum to
connect the antechambers. By being in this
room, you can connect them, too.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
She made the Tractatus
to link chambers. Your
presence can link them, too.

Original Japanese (Vita):
世界同士を結びつけている小部屋を起動させると、
オオガラスの内部に歪みが生じそこにある結界は
崩壊する。そう、キミこそが、文字通り鍵なんだ。
Official English (Switch):
You're the key to activating the antechambers,
and creating the disruption within Velkuvrana
that will destroy the ward.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You can link these rooms to weaken
Velkuvrana's protective ward.

Original Japanese (Vita):
レキテーちゃん、油断しないでね！
こいつの強さは、恐らくキミたちが倒した
幼体オオガラスと同等以上……！
Official English (Switch):
Don't be careless, Tractie! That thing's
just as strong as the hatched Velkuvrana
you defeated in the past...!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Careful, Tractie! It's as strong as
the Velkuvrana you defeated before!

Original Japanese (Vita):
進入後、連絡がとれていないのは、
ハーケン、ナスカ、ラヴュか。
あいつらが簡単にやられるとは思えないが……。
Official English (Switch):
I also haven't been able to make contact with
Harken, Nasca, or Labeline. I can't imagine
them being defeated so easily, but...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I can't reach Harken, Nasca
or Labeline either. Surely
they haven't fallen...

Original Japanese (Vita):
（実際、最初の小部屋を起動して以降、各世界を
繋ぐ階段のようなものはなくなっている……。）
Official English (Switch):
(In actuality, after we activated the first
antechamber, the stairways connecting
each world have vanished...)
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
After we activated the first
antechamber, the stairs
between worlds vanished...

Original Japanese (Vita):
おそらく、自立状態で“心臓”を
目指しているか、私の精神に呼応して
小部屋を探しているはず……。
Official English (Switch):
They're probably making their way to the
heart on their own, or maybe they're looking
for the other antechambers like I am...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Perhaps they're headed to
the heart alone, or seeking
antechambers like me.

Original Japanese (Vita):
相手を空間ごと転送するタイプの
オオガラスの化身“バーム”に出会った。
地上で戦ったときも、やっかいだったタイプだ。
Official English (Switch):
On the surface I encountered Bahm, another
avatar of Velkuvrana. I barely escaped his
attempt to seal me in another dimension.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I met Bahm, another of Velkuvrana's
avatars. I barely escaped its seal.

Original Japanese (Vita):
なるほどな、やったじゃないか、マズルカ。
状況は理解した。お前はその“楔の小部屋”
とやらを繋げてやれ。
Official English (Switch):
I understand now. Well done, Mezzaluca.
It's simply a matter of connecting these
keystone antechambers to each other.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Well done, Mezzaluca. Just link
the keystone antechambers.

Original Japanese (Vita):
魂の魔女様は、最も強い魔女をスピナだと
思っていたようだが、影の魔女の力を甘く見すぎだ。
Official English (Switch):
You always thought Spina was the strongest
of us. Perhaps you were underestimating my
power as the Shadow Witch.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You thought Spina strongest. You
underrated me as the Shadow Witch.

Original Japanese (Vita):
私ほど、暗殺向きな魔女はいない。
忘れたのか？　ドロニア型を単身でしとめたことが
あるのは私だけだ。
Official English (Switch):
No other witch is as skilled in assassination.
Have you forgotten that I'm the only one who
has killed a Dronya poppet by herself?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I'm the best assassin
here. I alone have killed a
Dronya poppet, remember?

Original Japanese (Vita):
けれど、生きている人と同じように見て、
感じて、話すなら、心があるのと同じなんだ。
怒り、怯え、悲しみ、喜び……みんなもっていた。
Official English (Switch):
They could still see, feel, and speak.
They could still experience anger, fear,
sadness, happiness... They all could.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
They could see, speak,
feel anger, fear, sorrow
and joy. All of them could.

Original Japanese (Vita):
それでも、私は彼女たちを送り出すしかなかった。
私たちは数が多いわけでもなかったし、
魔女を失うのはあまりにも痛手だったから……。
Official English (Switch):
But I had no choice. I had to send them.
Our resources were scarce enough already,
and we had already lost so many witches...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I had no choice. We had few resources
and had already lost so many witches.

Original Japanese (Vita):
マズルカの指先から焔がほとばしると
紅蓮の炎にのまれ、フルネラ型は燃え尽きた。
Official English (Switch):
Flames surged from Mezzaluca's fingertips,
and the pile of Funa poppets ignited in
a blaze of crimson fire.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Mezzaluca's fingers ignite the pile
of Funa poppets in red flames.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ふたりは“<player_name>”に唯一の希望を
見いだして過去に行った……。それをこちらに
送り届けるために、自らを犠牲にして……。
Official English (Switch):
They learned you were our only hope and went
back to the past for you, <player_name>...
They sacrificed themselves to bring you here.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
They saw <player_name> as
our only hope, went to the
past and died bringing you.

Original Japanese (Vita):
今のテネスは、キミ達がいた時間から百年はたって
いるんだけど、こちらからネルド達が過去に
飛んだのはたった、三ヶ月前の話なんだよ。
Official English (Switch):
This Tanis exists 100 years from the Tanis you
remember, but it's only been three months since
Neldo and Newton went back to the past.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Tanis is 100 years ahead of
yours, but Neldo and Newton
left just three months ago.

Original Japanese (Vita):
そもそも、キミたちが
ものの数ヶ月で成し遂げたルフランの攻略に
ドロニア様と私は１５年以上かかってるんだ。
Official English (Switch):
It took fifteen years for Dronya and me to
conquer the labyrinth of Refrain, but you
managed to conquer it in mere months.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Dronya and I spent fifteen
years conquering Refrain.
You did it in mere months.

Original Japanese (Vita):
キミのように魂が入り、
自立した力はなかった“妖路歴程”――。
それを人形兵に預けて探索していった。
Official English (Switch):
Our Tractatus de Monstrum was animate, but not
intelligent. It had a soul, but no will...
Still, I gave it to the puppet soldiers.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Our Tractatus had a soul
but no mind or will. Still, I
gave it to the puppet troops.

Original Japanese (Vita):
死、死んだ……
この前まで生きていたのに……はぁ……はぁ……
死んだ？　……い、息が……うっ……。
Official English (Switch):
They're not breathing...
They're...dead? Haaaah, haaah...
But they were alive just moments ago...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
They're not breathing...
Dead!? But they were alive
moments ago! Haaah...

Original Japanese (Vita):
余計な感傷を持ち込むな、マズルカ！
こいつはただの人形！　オオガラスの一部だ！
お前だって、そういっていただろ！
Official English (Switch):
Your childish sentiment has no place here!
This is just part of Velkuvrana, remember!?
Or do you not feel that way anymore!?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Stop being sentimental! It's
part of Velkuvrana, not
Dronya! Have you forgotten!?

Original Japanese (Vita):
お前、それを始めたのはいつだ？
悲しみの心、さびしい心……
消えていいものじゃないぞ！
Official English (Switch):
How long has it been since you started?
Sadness, loneliness... It's better to feel
these emotions than nothing at all!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Since when is feeling sorrow
or loneliness worse than
feeling nothing at all?

Original Japanese (Vita):
待って、ゾローク！　その傷、軽症じゃないよね？
右手折れてるよね？　左目みえていないよね？
私にはわかるよ。
Official English (Switch):
Zorok, wait! Your injuries are pretty serious.
Your right hand looks broken and your eye is
cloudy. Can you even see out of it?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Wait, Zorok! Your right hand is broken
and your eye is cloudy. Can you see?

Original Japanese (Vita):
あーあ、でもこんな姿に惑わされてたら
ドロニア様に怒られちゃうよ……
ドロニア様、厳しかったもの。
Official English (Switch):
*sigh* Still, Madam Dronya would be so mad
right now if she knew these things were getting
to me... She could be really strict...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
*sigh* Madam Dronya would
scold me for letting this
upset me. She was strict.

Original Japanese (Vita):
さ、残る部屋はあと１つ。
道中は、またきっとキツいだろうけど、
もうひと息だ！　おー！！
Official English (Switch):
Now then, there's only one antechamber left.
We've got a difficult road ahead of us, but
we're so close! I know we can do it! Hmph!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
One antechamber left! The road is
hard, but we're close! We can do it!

Original Japanese (Vita):
さあ、小部屋を全部解放したらどうなるのか？
首を洗ってまってなよ、バーバ、
いや、オオガラス！！
Official English (Switch):
I don't know what'll happen once all the
antechambers are activated, but I hope you're
ready, Baba! No...Velkuvrana!!!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I don't know what happens
when all are active, but get
ready, Baba! No, Velkuvrana!

Original Japanese (Vita):
こんなガチガチの結界で守られてたんじゃ、
レキテーちゃんでも起動できないかも……
い、いや、ダメだダメだ！
Official English (Switch):
Tractie, I don't know if you can activate the
antechamber while this ward is in place...
No, don't think like that!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
With this ward up, can you activate
it, Tractie? No! We have to try!

Original Japanese (Vita):
もう、やめるんだマズルカ……。
お前のカカ様――イサラの魂をまた
闇の奥底に封じるつもりか？
Official English (Switch):
Stop this, Mezzaluca... Do you truly intend to
seal Isara's soul in the depths of darkness?
You would do that to your own mother?
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Stop! Would you seal Isara's soul in
darkness? Your own mother's soul!?

Original Japanese (Vita):
妹のヨールに買ってあげたんですけど
色が好みじゃなかったみたいで……
僕が甘やかしすぎたのか、わがままで困ります。
Official English (Switch):
I bought this for Yhul but she doesn't like the
color. My sister's getting a little bratty, but
I guess it's my fault for spoiling her.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I bought this for Yhul, but she hates
the color. She's bratty; I spoiled her.

Original Japanese (Vita):
アハハ……すみません、
ゾロークさんに似合うと思ったんですが。
気にいらなければ誰かにあげてください。
Official English (Switch):
Hehehe... It's okay if you don't like it.
I just thought it would look nice on you.
You can give it to someone else if you want.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
It's fine if you dislike it.
I thought it'd suit you.
Give it away if you want.

Original Japanese (Vita):
私のお師匠様が見つけた、秘術だ。
誰にも教えていない……がな。
Official English (Switch):
A secret technique my master discovered.
She wouldn't teach it to me, though...
I had to learn it behind her back.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
It's my master's secret art.
She refused to teach me,
so I learned it in secret.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ルカさん、正直にいってあなたの魔女としての才能は
超一流ですよ。でも、ここでは……テネスでは
折角の素質が生かせていません。
Official English (Switch):
Miss Luca, I honestly think you could be
a first-rate witch. But...you can't reach
your full potential here in Tanis...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Miss Luca, you could be a great
witch! But Tanis limits your potential.

Original Japanese (Vita):
そのとき、丘の向こうから
爆発音とともに強烈な炎が立ち上り、
あたりが煙で充満した。
Official English (Switch):
Suddenly, a powerful explosion breaks out
from the other side of the hill! Intense flames
and thick smoke begin to fill the sky.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
An explosion erupts beyond the hill!
Flames and heavy smoke fill the sky.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ネルドが一号に飛びかかり
ドロニア型一号のほほに傷をつけるが
剣は受け止められてしまった。
Official English (Switch):
Neldo draws his sword and charges at the
Dronya poppet, slicing her face. But before
he can land another blow...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Neldo slashes the Dronya
poppet's face with his sword.
Before he can strike again...

Original Japanese (Vita):
ゾロークは、あたり一体を影でつつみこんだ。
影が消えると、三人はきえていた。
Official English (Switch):
Zorok floods the area with shadows.
When the shadows vanish, Zorok, Luca,
and Neldo are nowhere to be seen.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Zorok floods the area with
shadow. When it lifts, she,
Luca and Neldo are gone.

Original Japanese (Vita):
静かな地震だったが、マズルカはマナの動きから
ついにオオガラスの結界が解けたことを察知した。
Official English (Switch):
The ground trembles and Mezzaluca can sense
that the flow of mana has shifted. Velkuvrana's
barrier is no more.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The ground shakes. Mezzaluca
senses the mana shifting.
Velkuvrana's barrier is gone.

Original Japanese (Vita):
バーバがこれまでどれだけの世界で……
どんな思いをしたのか、私は知らない。
野心かもしれないし、悲劇かもしれない……。
Official English (Switch):
I don't know what you've experienced in all
those worlds you visited. Maybe you got what
you wanted, maybe you left disappointed...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I can't know what you faced
there. Maybe you found what
you sought, maybe not.

Original Japanese (Vita):
その刹那、
ボロボロのドロニア型一号が放つ電撃が
マズルカの首に掛かった刃を落とす！
Official English (Switch):
Suddenly, the Dronya poppet known as
Number One appears, and destroys
Velkuvrana's blade with an electric shock!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Number One appears and shatters
Velkuvrana's blade with lightning!

Original Japanese (Vita):
爆散の瞬間――
ドロニア型一号が、マズルカを地上に引き戻すと
身代わりになるように、オオガラスと共に消えた。
Official English (Switch):
Before the explosion can consume them,
Number One conjures a Mud Exit to the surface
and pushes Mezzaluca through.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Before the blast hits, Number
One opens a Mud Exit and
pushes Mezzaluca to safety.

Original Japanese (Vita):
身の内に魂を取り込み、
その魂は犯され、穢されましたが
誰ひとり彼女に感謝の言葉は述べませんでした。
Official English (Switch):
She housed the souls of the dead within her
body, tainting her own soul in the process,
and no one was alive to thank her.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
She held the dead's souls in
her body, tainting her own
soul, with no one to thank her.

Original Japanese (Vita):
そう、これはルフランの地下迷宮と
“<player_name>”と
魔女ノ旅団の物語。
Official English (Switch):
For this story has always been about the
labyrinth of Refrain, the Witch Brigade,
and <player_name>.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
A tale of Refrain's maze,
its Witch Brigade, and
<player_name>.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ドロニア様、ヴェルニアおばちゃん、カカ様、
三人のお墓をトト様のお墓の横につくるのが
私の夢だったんだけど無事達成したよ……へへへ。
Official English (Switch):
It took a while, but I finally made graves
for Madam Dronya, Auntie Velnya, and Mom.
They're right next to Dad's... Hehehe.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
I finally made graves for
Dronya, Velnya and Mom,
beside Dad's. Hehehe...

Original Japanese (Vita):
レキテーちゃん、
キミとの関係は言葉じゃ表現できないけど
私の力が必要なときは呼んでくれ。
Official English (Switch):
Tractie, I don't have the words to express
how much our relationship means to me, but
if you ever need my help, just call for me.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Tractie, words cannot say
what you mean to me. Call
whenever you need my help.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ここは迷宮探索の“拠点”となる場所です。
地下迷宮に挑むために必要な様々な支度を行います。
Official English (Switch):
The caravan will serve as your base of
operations. Before you face the labyrinth,
make sure to take all necessary precautions.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The caravan is your base. Prepare
carefully before entering the labyrinth.

Original Japanese (Vita):
また、“記録の書”はいわゆるセーブ機能です。
ここに出来事を記録すれば、ひと時この場を離れても
また続きから探索を再開することが可能です。
Official English (Switch):
"Record Memories" is the save data function.
After using it, you can continue exploring
from where you left off.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Record Memories saves your game,
so you can resume exploring later.

Original Japanese (Vita):
カルマは、特定のイベントや敵を倒すことで上昇し、
過去の行いによっては非常に高い数値になってしまう
場合があるかもしれません。
Official English (Switch):
Karma increases by defeating enemies and
completing certain events. Depending on your
actions, your karma can get rather high.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Defeating foes and certain events add
karma. Your actions can raise it high.

Original Japanese (Vita):
知らぬ間に危険な状況に陥ることもあるので
定期的に妖路歴程情報でカルマの値を
チェックしておくと安心です。
Official English (Switch):
Check your karma at the Tractatus Information
screen every now and then so you don't end up
in a dangerous situation.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Check your karma on the Tractatus
Information screen to avoid danger.

Original Japanese (Vita):
カルマは“魔女嘆願”で軽減できます。
カルマが溜まっている場合は拠点に戻り
これまでのカルマを清算しましょう。
Official English (Switch):
You can reset your karma by "Witch Petition."
If your karma is especially high, return to
base to fix your past mistakes.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Use Witch Petition to reset karma. If
it's high, return to base and clear it.

Original Japanese (Vita):
戦闘には慣れてきた頃でしょうか？
まだまだ色々な要素がありますので、
ここで軽く紹介させていただきます。
Official English (Switch):
Are you getting used to battling? There are
still lots of elements to go over, so I'll
introduce some of them here.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Used to battle yet? There are more
mechanics to cover. Let me explain!

Original Japanese (Vita):
共振や共鳴が発動すると、通常攻撃の威力や
ドナムの効果が向上します。
戦闘を有利に進めるために狙っていきたい要素です。
Official English (Switch):
Resonance enhances your basic attacks and
Echo enhances your donum effects. Mastering
these effects is the key to winning battles.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Resonance boosts attacks, Echo boosts
donum. Master both to win battles.

Original Japanese (Vita):
次に、“状態異常”についてです。
敵の攻撃やフィールドトラップによって
“状態異常”を受けることがあります。
Official English (Switch):
Let's go over status effects now.
Status effects can be applied by enemy
attacks or traps in the labyrinth.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Now, status effects! Enemies and
labyrinth traps can inflict them.

Original Japanese (Vita):
状態異常は戦闘中や戦闘終了時、フィールド移動中に
時間経過で自然回復しますが、リインフォースや
ドナムで回復できるものもあります。
Official English (Switch):
Status effects will heal on their own during
and after battle, but you can also heal them
using donum or Reinforcement.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Statuses fade during and after battle.
Donum or Reinforcement can heal them.

Original Japanese (Vita):
クリティカル・ゴア（以下“ＣＧ”）になると
腕や足など身体の一部をロストすることになり、
ステータスやＨＰに重大なダメージを負います。
Official English (Switch):
When a Critical Gore occurs, the target may
lose a limb or other body parts, and this will
reduce their stats and maximum HP.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Critical Gore can remove limbs or
parts, lowering stats and maximum HP.

Original Japanese (Vita):
なお、ＣＧは敵だけでなく“味方”にも発生します。
最大ＨＰの減少やステータスの減少など
“非常に危険な状況”に陥ります。
Official English (Switch):
Be aware that your brigade can be affected by
Critical Gore, too. Losing HP and stats will
put you in a dangerous position.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Your brigade can suffer Critical Gore
too, losing HP and stats. Beware!

Original Japanese (Vita):
身体の一部がロストしても人形兵は戦えますが、
危機的状況になる前に拠点に戻り、
“人形修理”を行うようお勧めいたします。
Official English (Switch):
Puppet soldiers can still fight despite their
missing parts, but you should return to base
and repair them before things get too dicey.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Puppets can fight with missing parts,
but go to base and repair them soon.

Original Japanese (Vita):
“共振”とは、連続して通常攻撃を行った際、
直前の攻撃との間に発生する現象のことです。
共振効果でその攻撃の“ダメージがアップ”します。
Official English (Switch):
Consecutive attacks have a chance to trigger
Attack Resonances. When one occurs, it will
increase the damage of your attacks.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Consecutive attacks can trigger
Attack Resonance, boosting damage.

Original Japanese (Vita):
人形兵たちは互いに“友好度”を持っており、
前に攻撃した人形兵への好感度が高いほど
共振しやすくなります。
Official English (Switch):
If a puppet soldier has high rapport with the
puppet soldier that attacked prior, an Attack
Resonance is much more likely to occur.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
High rapport between
consecutive attackers makes
Attack Resonance more likely.

Original Japanese (Vita):
共振が発生すると“パワーソース”が溜まり、
またパワーソースが溜まっているほど
“共振の発生率がアップ”します。
Official English (Switch):
When an Attack Resonance occurs, the power
source meter will fill. As the meter fills,
Attack Resonances are more likely to occur.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Attack Resonance fills the
power source meter, raising
the odds of more Resonance.

Original Japanese (Vita):
“パワーソース”とは、１戦闘中に溜まっていく
“場の力”のようなものです。
（ゲーム中では画面左上に表示されています）
Official English (Switch):
The power source meter appears at the top left
corner of the screen, and displays all the
power source that has accumulated thus far.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The power source meter at the upper
left shows your accumulated power.

Original Japanese (Vita):
パワーソースを消費して発生する
“共鳴”という要素もあります。
これはドナムにおける共振のようなものです。
Official English (Switch):
Triggering a Donum Echo will consume all the
power source in the meter. Donum Echoes are
very similar to Attack Resonances.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Donum Echo consumes the
whole power source meter,
much like Attack Resonance.

Original Japanese (Vita):
一番上の“編成”から紹介していきます。
編成は魔女ノ旅団に登録されたカヴン（結魂書）と
所属する人形兵たちの編成を行う画面です。
Official English (Switch):
First is the Brigade Formation menu, where you
can view your registered Covens (Soul Pacts)
and the puppet soldiers assigned to them.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Brigade Formation shows your
registered Covens and their
assigned puppet troops.

Original Japanese (Vita):
次に“キャラクター”ですが、
ここから各人形兵の装備を変更したり
ステータスを確認することができます。
Official English (Switch):
Next is the Characters menu, where you can view
the status of each puppet soldier and change
their equipment.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Characters shows each puppet soldier's
status and lets you change equipment.

Original Japanese (Vita):
装備、特に武器の変更はファセットごとの
得手不得手や、武器ごとの得意射程を気にしておくと
より武器の性能を引き出せます。
Official English (Switch):
To get the most out of your characters, pay
close attention to their weapons and the
strengths and weaknesses of their facets.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Match weapons to your
soldiers' facets, their
strengths and weaknesses.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ステータス画面では各種パラメーターの確認の他、
“あだ名”や“利き手”の変更なども行えます。
（利き手＝指定した手に持った武器で攻撃します）
Official English (Switch):
At the status screen, you can also change a
character's nickname, or the dominant hand
they'll use to wield their weapon.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
On Status, you can change a
soldier's nickname and dominant hand.

Original Japanese (Vita):
“アイテム”では人形兵の回復など消費アイテムを
使ったり、迷宮内で入手したアイテムを確認したりと
頻繁に利用することになると思います。
Official English (Switch):
From the Items menu, you can use items to heal
your puppet soldiers, and view the treasures
you find inside the labyrinth.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Use Items to heal puppet troops or
check treasure found in the labyrinth.

Original Japanese (Vita):
“未解封アイテム”は特別な方法で正しく解封すれば
真の能力に目覚めさせることが可能なのですが、
このメニューで強引に解封することも可能です。
Official English (Switch):
You can perfom a ritual at the caravan to
properly release the seal, or you can forcibly
remove the seal through the item menu.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Unseal them by ritual at
the caravan or force them
open via the Items menu.

Original Japanese (Vita):
“妖路歴程情報”では
レキテイ（プレイヤー）の覚えたスキルや
カルマの値などを確認できます。
Official English (Switch):
At the Tractatus Information menu, you can
view Tractie's karma score and any Tractie
Skills you've learned thus far.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Tractatus Information shows Tractie's
karma and learned Tractie Skills.

Original Japanese (Vita):
“中断”では、ここまでの探索内容を保存し、
ゲームを中断してタイトル画面に戻ります。
休憩する際などに活用してみてください。
Official English (Switch):
At the Suspend menu, you can create 
suspended save data to take a break from
playing and return to the title screen.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Suspend makes a temporary
save, pauses play, then
returns to the title screen.

Original Japanese (Vita):
なお“中断データ”は次の再開時に削除されます。
通常のセーブも忘れないようご注意ください。
Official English (Switch):
Be aware, suspended save data will be deleted
when you resume playing it. Do not forget to
create normal save data, too.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Suspend saves vanish once loaded.
Remember to make regular saves too!

Original Japanese (Vita):
編成メニューでは“リインフォース”を使って
人形兵たちを回復することもできます。
（“ディフェンスフォース”の習得が必要）
Official English (Switch):
Once you have obtained the "Reinforce Defense"
Tractie Skill, you can spend Reinforcement at 
the Formation menu to heal your puppet soldiers.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
With Reinforce Defense,
spend Reinforcement in
Formation to heal puppets.

Original Japanese (Vita):
全滅しないように適度に回復を行いながら
地下迷宮の最奥を目指しましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Keep your puppet soldiers in tip-top condition
so you're not annihilated, and make your way
to the end of the labyrinth.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Keep puppet troops healthy
to avoid annihilation and
reach the labyrinth's end.

Original Japanese (Vita):
この世界でも馬車小屋の施設のほとんどが
これまでと同じように利用できます。
少しだけ変化がありますので説明していきます。
Official English (Switch):
You have access to most of the caravan
facilities that you're used to, though some
have been changed slightly.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Most familiar caravan facilities
remain, though some have changed.

Original Japanese (Vita):
“魔女報告”は報告すべき相手がいないため、
新規の報告事項が出てくることはありません。
すべてあなた自身で考え、解決してください。
Official English (Switch):
Since you no longer answer to a witch, the
"Witch Report" facility is now defunct.
Basically, you're on your own now.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
With no witch in charge, Witch Report
no longer works. You're on your own!

Original Japanese (Vita):
“人形作業台”“錬金釜”“大商店”や
“記録の書”それに“編成メニュー”は
これまで通り使用できるようになっています。
Official English (Switch):
You can still use "Puppet Workbench,"
"Alchemy Pot," "Market," "Record Memories,"
and "Tractatus/Formation" like normal.

Original Japanese (Vita):
以上がこの“オオガラスの迷宮”における
拠点施設についての説明でした。
無事この世界が救われることを期待しています！
Official English (Switch):
This concludes the explanation of your base
within the labyrinth of Velkuvrana. It's up
to you to save this world!
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
That's your Velkuvrana
labyrinth base! Now it's up
to you to save this world!

Original Japanese (Vita):
“魔女嘆願”では魔女様にお願い事をし、
マナと引き換えに様々な願い事をかなえます。
Official English (Switch):
Through "Witch Petition," you can make requests
of Madam Dronya in exchange for mana, and she
will grant those requests.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Witch Petition lets you ask Dronya
for favors in exchange for mana.

Original Japanese (Vita):
地下迷宮の探索を助けるスキルの開放から
人形兵の名前の変更まで様々な種類があります。
Official English (Switch):
You can ask for many things, such as renaming
puppet soldiers or learning Tractie Skills to
help you explore the labyrinth.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You can rename soldiers
or learn Tractie Skills to
help explore the labyrinth.

Original Japanese (Vita):
序盤でできる願い事でお勧めなのが、迷宮内に
隠れているアイテムを見つけ出せるようになる、
“迷宮内でいろいろ拾いたい”です。
Official English (Switch):
To start off, I recommend that you request
to "Find More Items." This will let you find
hidden items inside the labyrinth.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Start by petitioning for Find More
Items to reveal hidden labyrinth loot.

Original Japanese (Vita):
なお、壁には壊せる壁と壊せない壁があります。
ミニマップを見ると壁の色が違っていますので
事前に壊せるかどうか確認しておきましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Walls are color-coded, and certain walls can't
be broken. Check the minimap before you waste
RF trying to break an indestructible wall.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Walls are color-coded; some
cannot break. Check the
minimap before wasting RF.

Original Japanese (Vita):
また、魔女嘆願で覚えられるレキテイスキル
“トレジャーハント”があれば、壁を壊しつつ
アイテム探しができ、探索の楽しみが広がります。
Official English (Switch):
Using "Witch Petition" you can learn the
Tractie Skill, "Treasure Hunt," and start
breaking walls to look for hidden items.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Learn Treasure Hunt via Witch Petition
to break walls and find hidden items.

Original Japanese (Vita):
新しく手に入れた“カヴン結魂書”の
“小隊の結魂書”について説明します。
Official English (Switch):
You just obtained the Soul Pact, "Witch Troop
Pact." Now seems like a good time to explain
Covens and Soul Pacts.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You got the Witch Troop Pact! Let's
explain Soul Pacts and Covens.

Original Japanese (Vita):
１つのカヴンに人形兵を複数登録するということは、
まずは単純に“攻撃の手数が増える”ということで
戦いを有利に進められます。
Official English (Switch):
Assigning multiple puppet soldiers to one
Coven as Attackers will increase the number
of attacks it can perform in battle.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
More Attackers in a Coven mean
more attacks it can make in battle.

Original Japanese (Vita):
普段はカヴン単位でしか行動を指示できませんが、
一人は攻撃、もう一人はアイテムで回復など
それぞれに異なる行動を指示することができます。
Official English (Switch):
Normally, you command a Coven as a single unit.
But this way, you can order one Attacker to
attack and the other to use a healing item.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Usually you order a whole
Coven, but one Attacker can
strike while another heals.

Original Japanese (Vita):
この枠に登録した人形兵は戦闘には参加しませんが
経験値をいくらかもらえ、結魂書によっては
特別な効果を発揮するものもあるようです。
Official English (Switch):
Supporters do not actively fight, but they
still receive EXP. Depending on the Soul Pact,
the role may also provide additional benefits.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Supporters don't fight,
but gain EXP and sometimes
other Soul Pact benefits.

Original Japanese (Vita):
サポーター枠まで活用できると、
戦略的にはずいぶん幅が広がり、うまく活かせば
有利な状況を作り出すことが可能です。
Official English (Switch):
Mastery of Supporter slots will greatly expand
your strategic options, and help you gain the
upper hand in battle.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Master Supporter slots to broaden
your tactics and gain the upper hand!

Original Japanese (Vita):
結魂書によって登録枠の数やその効果、
覚えるドナムなど様々な違いがありますので、
入手したらチェックしておきましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Soul Pacts can have a variety of slots and
effects, as well as different donum to teach.
Make sure you check each one you find.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Soul Pacts vary in slots, effects and
donum. Inspect each one you find!

Original Japanese (Vita):
迷宮には見たこともない財宝や秘宝があるといわれ、
行く手を阻む魔物や罠によって守られており、
それを求める冒険者たちを深みへと誘います。
Official English (Switch):
They say it's filled with wondrous treasures
that are guarded by monsters and traps. This,
of course, is enticing bait for adventurers.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Monsters and traps guard wonderful
treasure. That's bait for adventurers!

Original Japanese (Vita):
生身の人間がこの迷宮の探索を行うことは
賢い選択とはいえません。
迷宮の探索は“人形兵”に託すことにします。
Official English (Switch):
However, it's not, shall we say...wise for
humans to enter the labyrinth. So we'll be
sending puppet soldiers to explore instead.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The labyrinth isn't safe for humans,
so puppet soldiers will explore for us.

Original Japanese (Vita):
それでは、ルカが作った人形兵たちと共に
迷宮の探索を進めてみましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Now then, let's begin the exploration. Luca
worked really hard to make these puppets, and
it would be a shame not to use them.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Luca worked hard making
these puppets. Let's put
them to use and explore!

Original Japanese (Vita):
画面上部の“敵レーダー”は敵となる魔物の気配に
近づくと赤く光りはじめます。
用心して進みましょう。
Official English (Switch):
The enemy radar at the top of the screen will
glow red when you approach a monster. Proceed
with caution in such instances.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
The enemy radar at the top glows
red near monsters. Proceed carefully!

Original Japanese (Vita):
プレイヤーがフィールド上を移動すると
敵シンボルも移動し、接触すると戦闘になります。
Official English (Switch):
When you move in the field, enemy symbols will
move, too. If you make contact with each other,
a battle will start.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Enemies also move as you do. Touch
an enemy icon to start combat.

Original Japanese (Vita):
また“索敵”状態の敵にこちらから“不意打ち”を
しかけると、戦闘開始直後は敵が行動してこない
ことがあるので狙ってみるのもいいでしょう。
Official English (Switch):
If you surprise an enemy as it's patrolling,
the enemy might be too startled to act when
the battle starts. Something to think about...
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Catch a patrolling foe by surprise
and it may lose its first turn!

Original Japanese (Vita):
逆に“臨戦”状態の敵に背後から襲われると
“被不意打ち”となり、味方の人形兵が動けなくなる
可能性があるので注意しましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Conversely, if a patrolling enemy attacks you
from behind, you will be ambushed and your
puppet soldiers may not be able to react.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
If a patrolling foe hits you
from behind, your puppet
troops may be ambushed.

Original Japanese (Vita):
特に敵から逃げている時に、誤って壁にぶつかると
背後から追いつかれて被不意打ちになりやすいです。
あせる状況ほど慎重な行動を。
Official English (Switch):
If you run into a wall trying to flee from an
enemy, the enemy can ambush you easier. Always
keep a clear head in stressful situations.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Fleeing into a wall makes
enemy ambushes easier.
Keep calm under pressure.

Original Japanese (Vita):
また、フィールド上にゴミが溜まっていて
道を塞いでいることがあります。
破壊して通れますが周囲の敵には注意しましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Sometimes your path will be blocked by debris
on the ground. You can break through it, but
be careful of nearby enemies.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Debris may block your path. Break
it, but watch out for nearby enemies!

Original Japanese (Vita):
“潜む”は今は使えませんが魔女嘆願で
レキテイスキル“潜伏術”を習得することで
使えるようになります。
Official English (Switch):
You cannot hide right now, but you can obtain
the Tractie Skill "Silent Steps" through the
Witch Petition screen.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
You can't hide yet. Learn Silent
Steps through Witch Petition first.

Original Japanese (Vita):
身を潜めることで敵の視界に入っても
“一定の確率で見つからず”にやりすごせます。
（上位の“潜伏術”で確率をアップ可能）
Official English (Switch):
While hiding, you have a small chance to avoid
being detected by enemies. (Higher ranks of
"Silent Steps" will increase this chance.)
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
While hidden, you may evade
foes. Higher Silent Steps
ranks improve the odds.

Original Japanese (Vita):
装備者のカヴンが前衛後衛のどちらにいるかで
本来の能力を引き出せるかどうかが変わってきます。
Official English (Switch):
The strength of the vanguard and the rearguard
is dependent on how optimally you equip the
individual members of your Covens.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Equip Coven members properly for
their Vanguard or Rearguard positions.

Original Japanese (Vita):
例えば、“刀剣”“鈍鎚”“星嵐鎌”“戦術甲”は
“前衛”で威力を発揮し、“百花弓”“呪鐘”は
“後衛”でその威力を発揮する武器です。
Official English (Switch):
Swords, hammers, scythes, and katar are
strongest in the vanguard, while crossbows
and bells are strongest in the rearguard.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Swords, hammers, scythes and
katar favor Vanguard; bows
and bells favor Rearguard.

Original Japanese (Vita):
装備者の所属するカヴンのポジションと射程が
合わない装備の場合、武器の性能がダウンし
本来の能力を引き出すことができません。
Official English (Switch):
If a character's weapon range does not match
where its Coven is placed, the character's
performance with that weapon will be sub-par.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
A weapon outside its Coven's
optimal range performs poorly.

Original Japanese (Vita):
武器と前衛後衛の関係も考えて
カヴン編成や武器の選定を行いましょう。
Official English (Switch):
Always pay close attention to the dynamic
between the vanguard, the rearguard, and
the weapons your Covens are using.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Mind your Coven's position and
weapon ranges for best results.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ダメージを与える、またはダメージを受ける時、
まれに“スタン”状態になることがあります。
Official English (Switch):
You have a small chance of stunning enemies
whenever you damage them. Enemies, however,
can also stun you with their damage.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Damage may stun a foe; enemies
can stun you the same way.

Original Japanese (Vita):
スタン状態になっているキャラクターは、
そのターンで行うはずだった行動が
すべてキャンセルされてしまいます。
Official English (Switch):
Whenever a character or enemy is stunned,
any action they would perform that turn is
immediately canceled.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Whenever a character or enemy is
stunned, any action they'd perform
that turn is immediately canceled.

Original Japanese (Vita):
こういった魔物は次のターンで“強力な攻撃”などを
仕掛けてきますので注意してください。
“防御陣”コマンドを選択するのも手です。
Official English (Switch):
These prepared attacks are very powerful.
You can defend against them by selecting
the "Fortify Coven" command in battle.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Prepared blows hit hard. Use Fortify
Coven to defend against them.

Original Japanese (Vita):
これらはアクションが必要な場所に到達すると
画面中央に操作内容が表示されますので、
アクションを実行する場合は表示に従ってください。
Official English (Switch):
If a location requires an action to be
performed, the prompt for that action will
appear in the center of the screen.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
When an action is needed, its prompt
appears in the center of the screen.

Original Japanese (Vita):
すでにご存知かもしれませんが、
攻撃ドナムは“ＤＭＰ（ドナムパワー）”が
高い人形兵が使うほど威力が強くなります。
Official English (Switch):
You've probably figured out that offensive
donum is stronger when its used by a puppet
soldier with high DMP (Donum Power).
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Offensive donum is stronger
with puppet troops that have
high Donum Power (DMP).

Original Japanese (Vita):
つまり“マージナルメイズ”は攻撃ドナムを使うのに
向いていると言えます。また、“マッドラプター”や
“シアトリカルスター”も同様に得意と言えます。
Official English (Switch):
The Marginal Maze facet is among the best at
using offensive donum, though Mad Raptor and
Theatrical Star are solid picks, too.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Marginal Maze leads in attack
donum; Mad Raptor and
Theatrical Star excel too.

Original Japanese (Vita):
また、人形兵制作で設定する“スタンス”も
ドナムの攻撃力に大きく影響し、“ムーンサイド”が
が圧倒的に火力重視（防御軽視）です。
Official English (Switch):
Puppet soldiers can be assigned the Moon stance
when they're created to increase their DMP at
the expense of lower defenses.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
Moon Stance boosts Donum attack
power but greatly weakens defense.

Original Japanese (Vita):
ドナムはカヴンの全員で力を合わせて使うため、
攻撃ドナムの威力に関しては、カヴン内のメンバーの
ＤＭＰのバランスが重要になります。
Official English (Switch):
Because donum pulls its power from the Coven
as a whole, it's important to balance out DMP
among each member of the Coven.
English used (Vita R15 VWF02):
